title: Story of Elements Origins
description: Adds 10+ different Element-themed Origins based off the world of my original story A Story of Elements!
body:
This datapack adds 13 new Element-themed Origins to the Origins Mod. 

Each of the 10 base elements comes with powers and boons—but also drawbacks. Will you choose Fire, Water, Earth, Air, or one of several others?

The powers cover a large range of abilities—from attacks like shooting fireballs or summoning lightning, to utility abilities such as teleportation or shrinking and growing at will, to more random things such as immunity to getting damaged by berry bushes or being able to un-poison poisonous potatoes.

Additionally, three (as of right now) of the orgins can be upgraded by completing certain advancements, giving you the potential to unlock different ability sets...

These Origins are based off the Powers in my original story _A Story of Elements_.
